knimeNode.name: Spark Concatenate (HYIM)
knimeNode.shortDescription: Vertically concatenates two Spark DataFrames with column mapping.

intro.p: Vertically concatenates (appends rows of) two Spark DataFrames with configurable column mapping and automatic type resolution.

ul.li: Auto-mapping: Columns with the same name are automatically mapped.
Manual mapping: Override auto-mapping by specifying explicit column matches.
Type resolution: Same type kept; numeric promotion (Int→Long→Double); Left=String accepts any Right type as toString(); otherwise Right values become null.
Unmatched columns: Columns not in any mapping can be included (filled with null) or excluded, independently for left and right inputs.

tab.name: Column Mapping
tab.option: A table where each row maps a Left column to a Right column. Click a cell to select a column from a dropdown list. Use Auto Map to automatically match columns with the same name. Use Add Mapping to add a new mapping row.
How to handle left columns not present in any mapping. Include (fill with null): Adds them to output with null values for right-side rows. Exclude: Omits them from output.

How to handle right columns not present in any mapping. Include (fill with null): Adds them to output with null values for left-side rows. If the column name conflicts with an existing output column, a suffix is added. Exclude: Omits them from output.
